package_overview:
Four independent suites, one per package, all deliberately sequential (vitest fileParallelism: false, one Playwright worker, one VS Code instance at a time) because of the RAM rule. File headers cite acceptance-test ids from docs/m1-plan.md or docs/m2-plan.md; the two plans reuse AT1.x-AT6.x for different work packages (M1: markup, model/planner, semantic, workspace, extension, webview; M2: gate rules, engine/shadow, RunManager, proposals, extension, webview).

core (pure TS; `cd packages/core && npm test` = tsc -p tsconfig.test.json, then vitest run). Unit tests of markup (lexer, parser, serializer, values, edits, Lean ops; ported research cases, property, robustness and scale tests), the project model (statuses, edges, vocabulary, stale facts, subjects, diagnostics), the planner (D-11, delete, conditional proofs, carry-overs), graph.json and its committed schema, the protocol, and the M2 gate rules (G0, permitted set/freeze, evaluateRules incl. cheats, carriers, notices, normalisation, ghost adoption) plus proposal codecs/diff. Lean facts are hand-written JSON (test/fixtures/project), derived from text (project/helpers/fakeFacts.ts) or recorded from real Lean 4.35 (gate/realFacts). Fixtures are read through Vite `?raw` (core has no Node types).

runner (Node; `cd packages/runner && npm test` = vitest run with TELELEAN_NO_REAL_CLAUDE=1 and 180 s timeouts; `npm run typecheck` checks src and tests). Three layers. (1) Parsers on recorded Lean/Lake output and pure helpers (semantic/*, gate/pure, llm/streamJson, llm/argvEnv, lean/profile-shadow). (2) Real-Lean integration under runLean (systemd-run --user scope, bwrap, MemoryMax, toolchain v4.35.0 from ~/.elan, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4) on scratch copies of test-fixtures/ or mental_model/, git only in scratch repos: lean/*, semantic/refresh, gate/engine and gate/rules (Claude played by test-fixtures/gate/edits.json), shadow, workspace, proposal/build, integration/*, and run/walkthrough.e2e, where the FakeBackend plays test-fixtures/walkthrough/*.json: both readings plus a 20-script cheat catalogue (added axiom, sorry, weakened abbrev/type, unselected premise, rebind-target, helper lemma, definition-belief, redefined vocabulary, #eval, proof before freeze, edited words, give-up, goal-premise axiom/belief, derivation-premise proof, private lemma, two carrier cases, example). These assert that no telelean-<runId>-* systemd unit is left; several skip below 12 GB MemAvailable. (3) Fakes: run/manager.* via run/helpers (FakeEngine, FakeShadow, fake services, TrackingBackend, fake timers); llm/* against the FakeBackend, the CLI double fixtures/fake-claude.mjs with a real loopback MCP server, and the path-guard hook. Knobs: TELELEAN_TEST_TMP, TELELEAN_KEEP_TMP=1, TELELEAN_ALLOW_REAL_CLAUDE_VERSION=1.

extension: `npm run test:unit` (vitest; `vscode` aliased to test/unit/vscodeStub.ts) covers host logic, the edit applier, manifest/settings, the bundle, host restore and run wiring. `npm run build:all && npm run test:smoke`: scripts/smoke.mjs makes an isolated profile under $TELELEAN_TEST_TMP/vscode-<pid> (HOME, XDG_*, user-data, extensions, a ws with model copies) and runs `xvfb-run npx vscode-test` (VS Code 1.140.0, mocha tdd) as two instances: smoke (activation, board, boards with a fake workspace via testing.useRunner, model with the real workspace and Lean, runs with a FakeBackend) and e2e (e2e.test.ts, e2e-runs.test.ts driving the real board over CDP). Afterwards it fails on changes in the real ~/.config/Code, ~/.copilot, Chrome dirs or trash and on leftover processes or units. TELELEAN_SMOKE_GREP filters; `npm test` runs typecheck, build, unit and smoke.

webview: `npm run test:unit` (DOM-free store, run model, geometry, edges, formatting, card data, theme CSS); `npm run build && npm run test:e2e` runs Playwright (installed Chrome, headless, one worker) on the built bundle served at 127.0.0.1:41739 with a mock acquireVsCodeApi and the real CSP. Every spec fails on console, page or CSP errors; home-guard and chrome-tmp keep Chrome out of the real home. Root `npm test` runs every package's script.

Quota tripwires (plan 10.4): (1) TELELEAN_NO_REAL_CLAUDE=1 in both vitest configs, .vscode-test.mjs and smoke.mjs: createClaudeBackend refuses without a scratch resolve, and ClaudeCliBackend.startSession launches only node plus a test-fixture double (llm/tripwire, run/backend). (2) The Test-mode extension never builds the real backend; only testing.useRunBackend installs one (unit/runBackend, hostRuns, realRuns). (3) The live scripts are dry by default and refuse half-armed or tripwired runs (run/smokeScript, walkthroughScript, quotaTripwire). No test runs real Claude.

Docs vs code: core edit/conditional.test.ts cites a missing runner integration/conditional.test.ts (its real-Lean counterpart is integration/fixes.test.ts); helper headers (fakeMarkup, scenarios, parseFixture, gate/helpers, run/helpers/*, proposal/helpers, m2-carryover.spec) still describe stubs and gated blocks, but nothing is gated now; no test reads llm/fixtures/recorded-cli-2.1.314 although docs/m2-plan.md says tests use it; the walkthrough README says the RunManager unit tests use its scripts, but they script inline.
